title: Aam Shake
intro: Yes you can just blend everything together, but i like contrast so....

items: Mango, i use frozen mangoes that i keep in the freezer, allow to thaw for 10 minutes, it makes it easier to blend and easier on your mixer
1 cup milk, 3/4 cup to blend with the mangoes, 1/4 to blend the excess
1 - 2 tbsp monkfruit, if you prefer it slightly sweeter, this also depends on your mango sweetness, i dont use any
Mango, i use frozen mangoes that i keep in the freezer, allow to thaw for 10 minutes, it makes it easier to blend and easier on your mixer
1 cup milk, 3/4 cup to blend with the mangoes, 1/4 to blend the excess
1 - 2 tbsp monkfruit, if you prefer it slightly sweeter, this also depends on your mango sweetness, i dont use any

method: Blend the mango and milk together to form a thick shake
Pour into a glass and then add 1/4 cup of milk to the blender and let it blend a little, this takes out all the leftover and gives you a cool look on the final :)
Add it to the glass with the thickshake and add a 1 tsp of chia on top
Chia takes a few minutes to absorb liquid and its more paletable like that so stir and keep for a few minutes before you enjoy it :)
